name: Belgorod
pointBasis: UN WUP2025 population-weighted settlement locator; not a municipal boundary or parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The Belgorod regional Rosreestr administration's first-party announcement identifies the National Spatial Data System (NSPD) public cadastral map as the public cadastral-map service and says it is available without authorization. This establishes federal/regional cadastral-service custody; it does not establish a verified anonymous parcel response for the WUP point.
technicalBlocker: No source-native anonymous response containing a safe parcel identity and complete polygon was verified. The official NSPD homepage timed out during a bounded GET; the Belgorod municipal GIS returned its administration/login page, and its inspected map configuration referenced only a regional-boundary WFS layer, not parcel features.
scopeLimits: Cadastral-service custody is evidenced separately from open geometry. No full polygon was retained; no exact-point hit, citywide completeness, or countrywide completeness is asserted.
remainingUncertainty: The current NSPD map's internal public API, exact WUP-point coverage, parcel-layer schema, and citywide completeness remain unverified. The timeout and login wall are access findings, not evidence of parcel absence.
nextStep: Root review may independently inspect the current NSPD viewer/API configuration and qualify an adapter only after a bounded anonymous ID+geometry response is verified.
